{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hot Springs''' were several huge pools of mineral-laced water inside a crystalline cave on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carosi XII]]. Heated by underground [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity, the water provided a relaxing and healthy bath. The Hot Springs were connected to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Newlife Point]] by an underground subway system.
